title: Pre-K Tuition Agreement Terms: Discount for Additional Children of a Household
content:
**Term.** In Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the tuition sibling discount is decided across the household's enrollments of the same school year on Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based). The child registered first (earliest registration date, then earliest entry date) pays the full monthly tuition. Each other child receives the type's tuition sibling discount percentage on every tuition charge. An "other child" here is one of the household's enrollments on Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) for that school year, in status provisional or enrolled, whose registration date is earlier than this enrollment's, ties being broken by the earlier entry date. The window for the count is the school year of the tuition charge.

Children on Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) or on any other enrollment type are not counted, and Creek Kids Club or other program enrollments never count toward this discount.

## Who pays full tuition and who receives the discount

| The child's tuition-based enrollment, compared with the household's other tuition-based enrollments of the same school year in status provisional or enrolled | Tuition charge |
|---|---|
| no other such enrollment has an earlier registration date (and none on the same registration date has an earlier entry date) | full monthly tuition |
| at least one other such enrollment was registered earlier, or on the same registration date with an earlier entry date | monthly tuition less the sibling discount percentage, on every charge |

## Example (hypothetical household)

Three children are registered for the same school year: child A on Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based), registered 2 May; child B on Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based), registered 2 May with a later entry date than A; child C on Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible).
- Child A was registered first: full monthly tuition.
- Child B was registered on the same date as A but with a later entry date, so A counts as earlier: B receives the discount on every tuition charge.
- Child C is on the state-eligible type and is not counted; C does not change A's or B's position, and C carries no tuition.
- A Creek Kids Club enrollment of any of the children never counts toward the discount.
